Our Signature Dishes

A Taste of Cantonese Tradition.

Four dishes that define our kitchen — roasted, steamed and served the Cantonese way, made for the centre of the table.

Our Story

The Art of Cantonese Cuisine.

粵菜之藝，在於火候與用心。

Cantonese cooking is a craft of patience and precision. Roasts are hung and turned until the skin crisps just so. Broths simmer gently for hours. Seafood is steamed at exactly the right moment, so it arrives at the table sweet and tender.

At Shang Pin, we cook the way Cantonese kitchens have always cooked — with respect for the ingredient, care in the technique, and dishes designed to be shared around a round table.

01 · Fire

火候

Roasting and wok work tuned by experience, never by shortcut.

02 · Craft

刀工

Careful preparation, from marinating to the final cut at the table.

03 · Balance

平衡

Flavours that let each ingredient speak — never overpowered.

Do I need to book the roast goose in advance?

Yes — we recommend booking ahead. Message us on WhatsApp and we will confirm availability with you directly.

59, Jalan Indah 16/12, Taman Bukit Indah, 81200 Johor Bahru. Tap “Get Directions” above and Google Maps will take you here.
